full_judgment: Md. Ruhul Amin, J.:- This appeal, by leave, by the pre-emptee against the judgment and order of August 26, 1997 passed by a single Bench of the High Court Division in Civil Revision No. 2801 of 1994 making the Rule absolute. The Rule was obtained against the judgment and order of July 17, 1994 of the court of the District Judge, Lakshmipur in Miscellaneous Appeal No.2 of 1993 allowing the same and thereupon setting aside the judgment and order of November 29, 1992 of the Court of Assistant Judge, Ramganj, Lakshmipur, in Miscellaneous case No.1 of 1992 allowing the same. The Miscellaneous case was filed under section 96 of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act, 1950.
